info.title: Geocodio Universal API
info.description: Geocodio provides geocoding, reverse geocoding, data append, list geocoding, and distance APIs for addresses and coordinates in the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

get.description: Retrieves geocoding results from Geocodio for multiple addresses.

parameters.description: Optional maximum number of results per address.

schema.description: Optional maximum number of results per address.
